signs.name: Aries
signs.overview: Aries opens the zodiac wheel as its first spark — the instinct to act before the question is even fully formed. Ruled by Mars, this sign moves through life like a lit match: fast, bright, and unwilling to wait for permission.

signs.name: Taurus
signs.overview: Taurus is the zodiac's anchor — patient, sensual, and devoted to building something that lasts. Ruled by Venus, it finds the sacred in the physical: good food, soft fabric, steady love.

signs.name: Gemini
signs.overview: Gemini is the zodiac's quicksilver mind — endlessly curious, fluent in ideas, and allergic to standing still. Ruled by Mercury, it processes the world by talking it through, twice.

signs.name: Cancer
signs.overview: Cancer is the zodiac's heart-keeper — fiercely protective, deeply feeling, and ruled by the ever-shifting Moon. It builds a shell to protect a tender, perceptive inner world.

signs.name: Leo
signs.overview: Leo is the zodiac's radiant center — warm, generous, and built to be witnessed. Ruled by the Sun, it leads with heart and expects the room to feel a little brighter for it.

signs.name: Virgo
signs.overview: Virgo is the zodiac's quiet perfectionist — devoted to refining, healing, and making the chaos of life make sense. Ruled by Mercury, it serves through precision.

signs.name: Libra
signs.overview: Libra is the zodiac's diplomat — drawn to beauty, fairness, and the art of relationship. Ruled by Venus, it seeks the balance point between every opposing need in the room.

signs.name: Scorpio
signs.overview: Scorpio is the zodiac's depth-diver — intense, magnetic, and unafraid of what lives in the dark. Ruled by Pluto, it transforms by going through the wreckage, not around it.

signs.name: Sagittarius
signs.overview: Sagittarius is the zodiac's wanderer-philosopher — chasing meaning across borders, books, and belief systems. Ruled by Jupiter, it expands by refusing to stay still.

signs.name: Capricorn
signs.overview: Capricorn is the zodiac's mountain-climber — disciplined, ambitious, and willing to play the long game. Ruled by Saturn, it earns what it has through unglamorous, repeated effort.

signs.name: Aquarius
signs.overview: Aquarius is the zodiac's visionary outsider — independent, idealistic, and a few steps ahead of the current moment. Ruled by Uranus, it innovates by refusing to follow the existing script.

signs.name: Pisces
signs.overview: Pisces closes the zodiac wheel as its dreamer — porous, compassionate, and fluent in the language of feeling and imagination. Ruled by Neptune, it dissolves boundaries others insist on keeping.

Fire-Fire.label: Wildfire
Fire-Fire.blurb: Two flames meeting — thrilling, fast-moving, and a little dangerous. You understand each other's hunger instinctively, but neither of you is naturally good at slowing down, so burnout is the real risk, not boredom.

Earth-Earth.label: Bedrock
Earth-Earth.blurb: Steady recognizes steady. You build well together — shared values, shared pace — but without intentional sparks, this can settle into routine before either of you notices.

Air-Air.label: Open Sky
Air-Air.blurb: Endless conversation, shared curiosity, and a relationship that runs on ideas. The challenge is grounding any of it — plans get talked about more than they get done.

Water-Water.label: Deep Current
Water-Water.blurb: An emotional shorthand that needs no translation. Beautiful and occasionally overwhelming — two deep feelers with no one steering toward shore can drift into moodiness together.

Air-Fire.label: Catalyst
Air-Fire.blurb: Air feeds fire — this pairing is animated, social, and rarely runs out of momentum. Fire brings the spark, Air brings the oxygen; together you go further than either would alone.

Earth-Water.label: Roots & Rain
Earth-Water.blurb: Water nourishes what Earth has planted. This is one of the most naturally supportive pairings on the wheel — Earth gives Water structure, Water gives Earth feeling.

Earth-Fire.label: Slow Burn
Earth-Fire.blurb: Fire wants to move now, Earth wants to move right. Friction is likely at first, but if you find the shared rhythm, Fire warms Earth's patience and Earth gives Fire something solid to build on.

Air-Water.label: Mist
Air-Water.blurb: Air lives in thought, Water lives in feeling — translation takes real effort here. When it works, Air helps Water articulate what it feels, and Water helps Air actually feel something.

Air-Earth.label: Dust
Air-Earth.blurb: Air moves in ideas and possibilities; Earth moves in what's already proven to work. It can feel like two different languages, but Earth's practicality can give Air's vision somewhere real to land.

Fire-Water.label: Steam
Fire-Water.blurb: The most intense pairing on the wheel — equal parts chemistry and combustion. Water can extinguish Fire's spark, or Fire can boil Water dry, but if you both stay conscious of it, the transformation each brings out in the other can be profound.
